model_annotation:
The figure consists of two line plots, both illustrating the training rewards over steps for different models on easy and hard training sets. The x-axis represents the steps, is labeled "Steps", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0 to 500 in intervals of 100. The y-axis represents the training rewards, is labeled "Training Rewards", has a linear scale, and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 in intervals of 0.2 for the top plot, and from 0.0 to 0.2 in intervals of 0.1 for the bottom plot.

The top plot, labeled "Easy Training Set", compares the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" and "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" models. The "Llama-On-Policy-Easy" model is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.35 at 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating the range of values. The "Llama-LUFFY-Easy" model is represented by a red solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.37 at 500 steps, also with a shaded region.

The bottom plot, labeled "Hard Training Set", compares the training rewards for "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" and "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" models. The "Llama-On-Policy-Hard" model is represented by a blue solid line, starting at approximately 0.05 at 0 steps and decreasing to around 0.0 at 100 steps, remaining steady thereafter. The "Llama-LUFFY-Hard" model is represented by a red solid line, starting at approximately 0.0 at 0 steps and increasing to around 0.15 at 500 steps, with a shaded region indicating the range of values.
